entities.summary: Jacob ben Asher, also known as Ba'al ha-Turim as well as Yaakov ben haRosh, was an influential Medieval rabbinic authority. He is often referred to as the Ba'al ha-Turim or simply HaTur, after his main work, the Arba'ah Turim.
